trading_pulse_pnl_currency.single_currency_semantics: When a runtime ledger or constituent positions/marks/fills report a single unambiguous ISO currency (e.g. TWD), populate pnl_currency='TWD' and pnl_currency_status='single_currency' (pnl_currency_reason=null) on row.performance_context, row.telemetry_summary, row, data.summary, cards[card_id='pnl'].details, and rankings.data.summary.
trading_pulse_pnl_currency.mixed_currency_semantics: When constituent positions within a ledger or constituent ledgers across the portfolio report multiple distinct currencies without FX conversion (e.g. TWD and USD), keep pnl_currency=null with pnl_currency_status='mixed' and pnl_currency_reason='mixed_currency_without_fx' (and metric_reasons.pnl_comparison='mixed_currency_without_fx').
trading_pulse_pnl_currency.empty_or_unknown_semantics: When a ledger has 0 fills, no active positions, and no currency facts, keep pnl_currency=null with pnl_currency_status='unknown' and pnl_currency_reason='empty_ledger' (or 'no_currency_fact' / 'ambiguous_position_currency' when non-empty observations lack unambiguous currency facts).
